title: Image Generation
description: Generate a set of themed images for a marketing campaign using AI image generation.
prompt: Generate a set of 5 marketing images for a coffee brand called 'Morning Ritual'. The images should depict: 1) a steaming cup of coffee on a wooden table with morning light, 2) a barista pouring latte art, 3) coffee beans in a burlap sack, 4) a person enjoying coffee while reading a book, and 5) a coffee shop storefront at sunrise. Use a warm, inviting color palette with soft lighting.
